jobs.title: Associate Administration - Plattform #Staatsmodernisierung (gn)
jobs.reason: An entry-accessible administrative/finance-coordination role at a reputable policy school, and the candidate's project-administration and funding-allocation experience at the German Rectors' Conference maps reasonably well; German and English requirements are met. However, this is an administrative/financial-coordination post rather than research or policy analysis, sitting outside the candidate's core interest zones, which holds the score down.

jobs.title: studentische Hilfskraft (w/m/d)
jobs.reason: This is a studentische Hilfskraft (working-student) role, which is excluded as a matter of policy regardless of field fit. Even as a research-adjacent economics institute, the level makes it ineligible.

jobs.title: Pflichtpraktikum
jobs.reason: This is a Pflichtpraktikum (mandatory internship), which is excluded as a matter of policy as it is a student internship rather than a genuine paid professional role. The level disqualifies it regardless of topic.

jobs.title: Praktikum in den Literatur- und Oralturpraktiken für die Reihe Middle Ground (m/w/d/k)
jobs.reason: This is an internship (Praktikum) requiring current enrolment in a humanities/arts/cultural-management programme, which is excluded as a matter of policy. The literature-festival cultural-management focus also sits well outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Bürosachbearbeitung
jobs.reason: The role requires, as an essential, a completed vocational training (Berufsausbildung) as an office/administrative or events clerk, or an equivalent qualification — the candidate does not hold this and it is an administrative clerk position, not a research or policy role. The work (invoice checking, ERP payment processing, filing) is clerical and outside the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Bürosachbearbeiter (m/w/d) in der Vergabestelle in Teilzeit
jobs.reason: Requires a completed vocational training (Ausbildung) in office management / administration and specific knowledge of public procurement law (Vergaberecht) plus procurement software — essential qualifications the candidate does not hold. This is a clerical procurement administrator role with no research or policy content and no interest alignment.

jobs.title: Beschäftigte/Beschäftigten in der Informationstechnik (w/m/d) im Referat Kommunikationstechnik
jobs.reason: Requires as an essential a completed IT vocational qualification (Fachinformatiker/IT-Systemelektroniker or equivalent) plus at least two years' relevant network-technology experience, neither of which the candidate holds. This is a hands-on communications-technology / network-infrastructure role entirely outside the candidate's research and policy profile.

jobs.title: Praktikant*in im Bereich Gesundheitssystemstärkung
jobs.reason: This is explicitly an internship (Praktikum), which is excluded as a matter of policy, and it also requires current enrolment or a very recent graduation. It further seeks a public-health / pharmacy background outside the candidate's field, so it is a poor topical fit as well.

jobs.title: Trainee Data & Information Specialist (Wissenschaftlicher Dokumentar/Informationsspezialist) (w/m/d)
jobs.reason: This is a genuine paid postgraduate traineeship (not a Werkstudent/internship exclusion) requiring a recent Master's, which the candidate will hold — level fits and the profile asks only basic Python. However, it is a library/media-documentation and archiving qualification track (MAS) that sits well outside the candidate's core interest zones and does not build on their international-law/policy research strengths, so interest and paper fit are weak.
jobs.salary: Tariff group G/Stufe 1 (plus holiday pay, family allowance, pension, transit subsidy)
